test_case_name: Access General Terms & Conditions of Carriage from Cookie Policy Page

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the Cookie Policy page
And then check that the 'General Terms & Conditions of Carriage – Ryanair Help Centre' page is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to Terms of Use from General Terms & Conditions of Carriage Page

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the Cookie Policy page
Click 'Terms of Use' link on the General Terms & Conditions of Carriage page
And then check that the 'Terms of Use' page is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to Privacy Policy from General Terms & Conditions of Carriage Page

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the Cookie Policy page
Click 'Privacy Policy' link on the General Terms & Conditions of Carriage page
And then check that the 'Privacy Policy' page is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to Cookies Policy from General Terms & Conditions of Carriage Page

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the Cookie Policy page
Click 'Cookies' link on the General Terms & Conditions of Carriage page
And then check that the 'Cookies' policy page is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to Contact Us from General Terms & Conditions of Carriage Page

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the Cookie Policy page
Click 'Contact us' link on the General Terms & Conditions of Carriage page
And then check that the 'Contact us' page is displayed

test_case_name: Open Cookie Preferences from General Terms & Conditions of Carriage Page

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the Cookie Policy page
Click 'Cookie Preferences' link on the General Terms & Conditions of Carriage page
And then check that the cookie preferences modal or page is displayed

test_case_name: Search for Information on General Terms & Conditions of Carriage Page

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the Cookie Policy page
Type $name into the 'I am looking for…' input field
Click 'Search' button
And then check that the search results are displayed according to the entered query

test_case_name: Access FAQs from General Terms & Conditions of Carriage Page

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the Cookie Policy page
Click 'FAQs' link on the General Terms & Conditions of Carriage page
And then check that the FAQs page is displayed

test_case_name: Open Navigation Menu on General Terms & Conditions of Carriage Page

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the Cookie Policy page
Click 'Toggle navigation menu' button
And then check that the navigation menu is expanded

test_case_name: Change Language to Ireland (English) on General Terms & Conditions of Carriage Page

intents.intent: Click 'General terms & conditions of carriage' link on the Cookie Policy page
Click 'Ireland (English)' button
And then check that the language or region is set to Ireland (English)
